name: Bimetallic Escapement Mesa
core_rationale: Tenth thermal-compensated brass-and-invar plateau of Continent 02 where Krono's bimetallic balance coils flex with the steppe sun to keep the master clockwork in phase.
local_conflict: Thermal-coil automatons and invar-shelled armadillos patrol the flexing bimetallic arch-bridges.

portal_edges.lock_reason: Rapid thermal-coil expansion across Solar-Coil Overlook requires Chronometer-Master Invar's Compensator Balance Key.

mystery_hook.in_world_rumor: Tinkers say the bridges of Bimetallic Escapement Mesa arch three meters higher at noon than at midnight as the twin metals expand and contract.
mystery_hook.visual_silhouette: Laminated copper-and-silver balance coils curving over a sun-drenched brass mesa.
mystery_hook.unanswered_question: What solar chronometer relay crowns Solar-Coil Overlook?

causal_continuity.evidence: Directly inherits god-krono-brass-titan and scar-brass-faultline along the eastern thermal-compensated plateau of Continent 02 and connects west to Flywheel-Governor Hub.

fantasy_and_wonder.evidence: Laminated copper-and-invar balance coils flexing with the steppe sun across a brass mesa.

character_scale_consistency.evidence: Specifies 12.5m bimetallic ramp walkways, 0.58m chronometer workbenches, and 0.14m brass risers tailored to 1.05m characters.

spatial_and_ecological_consistency.evidence: 2x2 connected matrix at [0,1], [1,1], [1,1] floor -1, and [1,0] with construct and carapace monster families.

intentional_mystery_discipline.evidence: Preserves hunting-area-solar-coil-overlook in Mystery status behind a Fog of Lore portal with explicit lock_reason.
